arguments.where_clause: amount_usd_cents > 100000 AND card_id IN (SELECT id FROM cards WHERE card_type = 'Debit')
arguments.explanation: Flags transactions over $1,000 made with a debit card. The application will measure the rule against the fraud labels. The month-by-month breakdown is not part of this step.
assumptions: 'Debit card' means card_type = 'Debit' only. Prepaid debit cards ('Debit (Prepaid)') are not included.
'Over $1,000' means strictly more than 100000 cents. A transaction of exactly $1,000 is not flagged.
Only one action can run per reply, so this proposes the rule and leaves out the monthly results. You can ask for the rule's results by month (January to October 2019) in a follow-up question.
